tour.welcome: Hi {name}! Let me walk you through the basics. Sound good?
tour.personnel: Nothing happens without a team. Hire at least one engineer first.
tour.marketing: Great products need to be heard of. For a start I suggest {amount} marketing budget.
tour.development: Active developments speed up with budget. Try {amount} per quarter.
tour.research: Research pays off long term. {amount} is a solid starting point.

tips.needRole: You're spending {amount} on {area}, but you have no {role} on the team. The money is wasted.
tips.revenueGrew: Your revenue climbed to {revenue}. Marketing of ~{amount} would be appropriate now.
tips.saturated: Your {area} budget is past the saturation point. More team beats more money now.
tips.lowMorale: Team morale is at {morale}% — consider a bonus or a break.
tips.cashLow: Your cash reserve is shrinking. Lower unproductive budgets or pause research.
